limitations: arms produce different mutant populations, so this compares test suites on each arm's own code, not test quality in isolation; timeouts count as kills and are reported separately; the timeout baseline includes container start and source export time
method: single-site mutants of changed production lines (relational boundary, equality negation, boolean connective, condition negation); at most one mutant per line, ten per attempt, sampled by sha256 order and round-robin over operators; each runs the frozen coverage-profile command; kills confirmed by one rerun
